subject.why: The vintage cream suitcase record player is instantly recognisable, complete with its lid open, controls, tonearm, and the requested red heart-shaped vinyl record.

category.why: The record player rests on a stylized polished wooden surface with a soft shadow, set against a clean, prop-free pink gradient wall.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The record player is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all sides and no parts cut off.

colour.why: Warm, bright, and saturated palette with clear contrast between the cream suitcase, the red record, the wood surface, and the pink background.

detail.why: Shapes and surfaces are clean and stylized without distracting micro-textures, scratches, or clutter.

style.why: Features chunky, rounded 3D volumes with a soft satin sheen, closely matching the established game art style.
